messages:
lina: quick heads-up  user can't start the sample app on Vercel Edge: `SyntaxError: Cannot use import statement outside a module` when importing @redwood/inference.
rob: hmm are they using the sample unchanged? we default to dual-pkg with conditional exports. sometimes bundlers on edge treat the package as cjs.
kevin: yup. Vercel's edge runtime expects pure ESM. If the resolver picks the `require` path or falls back to `main`, you'll hit that error.
tasha: got the repro from the user. their package.json has "type": "module" and they do `import { Client } from '@redwood/inference'` in an edge function. local node ESM works.
lina: also they said TS server couldn't find types (no intellisense). looks like `./types` export separated from main export confused their tooling.
rob: two problems colliding: runtime chooses wrong entry, and types resolution isn't picked up. We should avoid separate `./types` export unless necessary.
kevin: quick mitigation: add an explicit "./edge": "./dist/esm/index.mjs" export and update sample to `import { Client } from '@redwood/inference/edge'`. Ugly but will unblock.
tasha: also noticed retry/auth code crashed in the edge bundle for them: stack trace shows `setTimeout` undefined because our retry util pulled in a Node timer polyfill in the CJS build and the ESM build got tree-shaken differently.
rob: ouch. that means our conditional imports change runtime deps. We need to make edge-friendly shims explicit and avoid Node-only modules being required in any code path used by the edge bundle.
kevin: proposal: 1) make ESM the primary export for `.` and make `require` a fallback (flip default export order), 2) add `module` and `browser` fields pointing to ESM assets, 3) consolidate types under the main export ("./": { "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts", "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js" }), 4) add `./edge` alias for the short term, 5) fix retry util to use web-compatible timers or guard Node-only code behind runtime detection.
lina: sounds good. who wants to own the PR?
rob: i'll take the exports/types flip + README update for the sample app.
asha: (typo) tasha: i'll file a small smoke CI job to run the sample on a Workers/Vercel edge emulator and fail the build if runtime throws. cc @ci-bot
ci-bot: created issues #4230 (exports: ESM-first + types consolidation), #4231 (edge smoke CI), #4232 (fix retry util web-timer safe) 44d
kevin: once PRs land, let's publish a patch and update the sample app readme with the temporary `@redwood/inference/edge` import so users are unblocked. Also add a short doc about edge runtime gotchas (module resolution, timers, global fetch differences).
rob: noted. will include migration notes and a changelog entry.
lina: thanks everyone, keeping this thread as the quick log for this issue. if others hit similar, drop repros here.
